title: Shah Mosque, Mashhad

buildingCutout.basis: Replace the original mapped mosque mass within the named outline. The separate neighboring hammam keeps its own representation.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the northern bazaar approach.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap Masjid-i Imam outline corroborated by architectural field surveys.
mapIdentity.scope: The ten-point named outline of Masjid-i Imam, a distinct way sharing stepped western and southern boundaries with the separately mapped Mehdi Qoli Beyk Hammam.

note: Seyyedi gives a north-facing iwan 9.4 m high and outer dome 17.4 m high. The field survey describes the central square dome chamber, transitional drum, four side niches and the strongly projecting minarets. The recorded iwan span and depth are approximately 4.95 and 4.2 m.
